name: [🤖 ROBOT] Grow a Brainrot
desc:
🌱 Welcome to Grow a Brainrot! 

⭐️ NEW Mega Community Egg
🎯 You can only mix brainrots one time now, so rare brainrots will remain rare! 

🥚 GET TRALATAN ON COMMUNITY EGG!!

Use Code: 
MERRY25 for $2025
RANDOM for a random egg 🎲
SPOOKY for a pumpkin egg 🎃
COMMUNITY for an OC community egg ✊

👽 Alien plants have invaded Grow a Brainrot!
⚔️ Fight to protect your brainrots
🥚 Collect Alien Plant eggs from defeated invaders
🌱 Harvest NEW plant mutations from your own pet aliens

👍 Like the game and join the group
⭐ LIMITED BRAINROT
👩🏻‍🍳 MIX BRAINROTS

Grow your very own Italian Brainrot! 💀

🥚 Buy eggs
🐣 hatch monsters
💪 flex your creations
👊 Battle other brainrots 
🌀 Mix them to create crazy combinations!

[How to Play]
Buy eggs from the farmer
Lay them in your farm
Hatch them to get brainrots
Sell them or collect rent
Repeat until your brainrot is cured

🔥 Thanks for playing, remember your eggs and brainrots grow offline!
